_about: THE ROSTER (COMBAT [bestiary], rule 42a): every Battle Brothers enemy type in the library, its Bohemia family, the ONE lesson the family teaches, its name on the board, its weight in each act, and whether the fight fields it yet. Built by tools/bohemia_combat_the_roster.py from enemies.json and ours.json, never by hand; a type's numbers stay on its row in enemies.json. Skins, names and lessons not yet in the fight are drafts for WORDS and WORLD (draft: true). A modder adds a family to ours.json's enemy_tiers.mix and act_weights and reruns the tool.

floor.quote: THE FLOOR FOR BOHEMIA, HIS RULE: at least 12 factions, 75 enemy types, 17 beasts, 3 bosses, and champions.

families.skin: ROAMING CREWS: scavengers, poachers, marksmen, a leader with a name
families.lesson: Undisciplined: they run at you even when they should shoot; drop the leader and the rest waver.

families.skin: THE FACTIONS' HOME-BASE GUARDS (the Mob, the Trades, the Network, the Reds...), armoured, in colour
families.lesson: A shield line with long arms behind it: break the line or go round it.

families.skin: OTHER COMPANIES like yours, the rival crew with a runway look
families.lesson: A crew like yours: every man has a job; read his gear before you pick the fight.

families.skin: THE LAB-BREAKOUT PEOPLE: cult-like keepers who walk with beasts
families.lesson: They come with beasts and a drum: the beast hits first, the keeper hits hardest.
Slings and fast blades from the dunes: they hit and fade into the sand.

families.skin: THE STRIP'S CASINO SECURITY: the only faction with working heavy guns and a mortar
families.lesson: Guns and a mortar: stay out of the open and close the distance.

families.skin: THE AMALGAMATION'S FAITHFUL (act 2 and 3 grow them)
the militia, the caravans and the townsfolk
families.lesson: Many and green: their captain holds them together.

families.skin: KIDS AND RUNNERS on bikes and dirt quads with slings and nets
families.lesson: They throw, net you and run: do not chase them, shoot them.

families.skin: THE HEAVY: exo-suit men, crash-bar shields, they push you off the tile
families.lesson: They shove you off your tile: put your back to a wall and shoot before they reach the line.

families.skin: THE MECHANIC (his words): a man who keeps reviving his robots; kill him and the machines drop
families.lesson: Kill him first and the machines drop; a head shot keeps one down.

families.skin: THE OLD ORDER'S MACHINES: security drones and exo-suited remains still running the last order they were given
families.lesson: A line that holds and never breaks: bring armour-breakers and patience.

families.skin: DE-EXTINCT ANIMALS out of the labs when the dollar died (rule 42, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_BEASTS_ARE_LAB_MADE_AND_THE_BESTIARY_FLOOR_9_29_26.md)
THE AMALGAMATION'S HAUNTING as act one sees it (rule 134(e)): the dead who came back, the scream its broadcast
families.lesson: They fight your nerve from range: walk up and hit them, they break like smoke.

beasts.lesson: They flank: keep your line closed.
Faster and harder: shoot them on the way in.
They take the weak at the edge.
They eat the dead and grow: leave no body for them.

beasts.skin: a swarm of lab things (no giant spiders)
beasts.lesson: They net and poison: kill the nest.

beasts.skin: the short-faced bear or the ground sloth
beasts.lesson: It regenerates and throws: finish it fast.
It regenerates and throws: finish it fast.

beasts.skin: a night thing (the horror line, not an animal)
beasts.lesson: It puts your men to sleep and blinks: wake them, then hunt it.
She charms your own: kill her and they are yours again.

beasts.skin: the mesquite or Joshua-tree walker (a maybe)
beasts.lesson: It spawns saplings: burn or break the trunk.

beasts.skin: the big monitor lizards the Vegas exotic-pet trade kept
beasts.lesson: Two bodies and acid blood: hit the head, not the tail.
It drags and crushes: never stand alone at the water.

beasts.skin: the swarm (fought with fire, smoke, water and walls)
beasts.lesson: It splits when hurt: hit it hard once.
It screams at your nerve: walk up and hit it.
Cut the arms that hold your men, then the body.

beasts.skin: the mammoth (OUT by his fifth votes: every beast survives the Mojave; WORLD replaces it)
